title: Stability: Operational Partnership Dossier — Cross-functional Reliability Program
summary: This dossier captures a new execution model for rolling SLO adoption across product and platform teams by treating reliability work as a time-boxed partnership rather than a handed-over project. It documents roles, cadence, baseline measurement, a three-phase rollout pattern, and pragmatic SLO templates tailored for Redwood Inference workloads.
goals:
- Establish shared SLOs (latency and availability) for five candidate services by end of Q2 2026
- Deliver a repeatable engagement pattern (lighthouse partner -> scale) for 6 cross-functional teams by Q4 2026
- Reduce P99 tail latency by 30% for high-throughput model endpoints within dedicated infra budgets
- Create an on-call runbook handoff playbook and two automated dashboards per service
milestones:
1) Lighthouse selection and kickoff (Apr 20–May 3, 2026) — identify 2 services and partners
2) Baseline measurement (May 4–May 24, 2026) — collect SLI distributions, error budgets, operational gaps
3) Localized remediation sprints (May 25–June 21, 2026) — infra + product paired fixes, experiment with batching/cache policies
4) SLO formalization & runbook creation (June 22–July 5, 2026) — finalize SLOs, alert thresholds, service-specific runbooks
5) Scale pattern rollout (Jul–Sep 2026) — onboard additional teams in two-week partnership waves

engagement_model: We propose a 6-week partnership block per lighthouse service: weeks 1–2 discovery and baseline; weeks 3–4 paired remediation and SLI tuning; weeks 5–6 formalization (SLOs, alerts, runbook) and knowledge transfer. Each block includes a weekly 30-minute stakeholder sync and a bi-weekly engineering deep dive. The model emphasizes paired ownership: SRE + product engineer assigned for the block.
routines:
- Weekly stakeholder sync: 30m, agenda: progress, blocker removal, decisions
- Deep dive workshops: 60–90m every other week for architecture, tracing, and performance profiling
- Daily async status in #reliability-collab for lighthouse weeks 3–4
- Post-block retro and action log within 3 business days
measurement_plan: Metrics collected per service: request latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), tail QPS, error rate (4xx/5xx), cache hit ratio, batching efficiency, CPU/GPU utilization per model variant. Baseline period = 14 days of production-like traffic. Define SLIs with clear measurement windows and sampling strategy. Use traces to attribute latency to network, kernel exec, or serialization layers.
slo_templates:
Example 1 (API latency): '95% of requests complete under 250ms over a 30d rolling window' — target owner: Hosted API product; alert when 30d window breaches for 2 consecutive days.
Example 2 (Model-serving availability): 'Model-serving cluster returns healthy inference responses for 99.9% of requests over a 7d window' — target owner: Dedicated infra; alert on 7d error budget burn rate > 50%.
Note: templates include owner, measurement source, alert cadence, and rollback criteria.
alerts_and_escalation: Alerting policy components: Severity levels (P0/P1/P2), automated throttles for noisy signals, on-call playbooks linked in alerts, and a secondary SRE escalation chain. For systemic regressions, trigger an ops war-room and involve product leads within 30 minutes of confirmation.
runbook_handoff: Runbook structure: purpose, normal vs degraded behavior, immediate mitigation steps, longer-term remediation notes, owners, relevant dashboards, and post-incident checklist. Handoff steps: 1) co-author runbook in week 5 2) verify runbook via tabletop exercise 3) sign-off by product + SRE before block close
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Measurement fidelity gaps (instrumentation blind spots) — Mitigation: Observability team to prioritize missing metrics in first 2 weeks.
Risk: Competing prioritization from product squads — Mitigation: Leadership-backed OKR alignment and time-boxed partnership commitments.
Risk: Alert fatigue — Mitigation: introduce temporary rate-limited alerts and automated suppression during remediation experiments.
resource_estimate: Per lighthouse block: 0.4 FTE SRE (paired), 0.6 FTE product engineer, 0.1 FTE observability for dashboards, ~3 GPU-hours/day for load testing during remediation windows. Estimate per service budget: ~$15k in people + infra for initial block.
